basic.name: 普通攻击：痛打呆子
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎发动至多四段的攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
在杜苏拉和安娜塔莎攻击期间，丽娜执行其他行动，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to attack up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's Basic Attack combo count.

special.name: 特殊技：砸扁笨蛋
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
指派安娜塔莎发动下砸攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：笨蛋消失魔法
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎发动持续下砸攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，将触发[快速支援]。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to unleash a continuous downward smash attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

dodge.name: 闪避：抚平裙摆
dodge.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodge.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dashAttack.name: 冲刺攻击：突然惊吓
dashAttack.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dashAttack.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
dashAttack.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
dashAttack.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：邦布回魂
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方旋转飞出并触发爆炸，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：侍者守则
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并生成球形电场，造成大量电属性伤害；
杜苏拉和安娜塔莎在推进期间无法响应[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]的指令，但可以通过发动[普通攻击：赶走傻瓜]将其召回丽娜身边；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, Special Attacks, and EX Special Attacks, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

ultimate.name: 终结技：女王的侍从们
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并发动高速回旋，造成大量电属性伤害；
杜苏拉和安娜塔莎在推进期间无法响应[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]的指令，但可以通过发动[普通攻击：赶走傻瓜]将其召回丽娜身边；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，将触发[快速支援]。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：二拍的阿勒芒德
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方旋转飞出并触发爆炸，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 回避支援：三拍的库朗特
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：四拍的加沃特
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并生成涡旋电场，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间，可以快速衔接[强化特殊技：笨蛋消失魔法]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to continuously advance while generating a vortex of electricity, dealing Electric DMG.
While using this skill, Rina can quickly chain into EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

basic.name: 普通攻击：晨间清扫（潜能觉醒）
basic.trigger: 当丽娜发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]后，进入[一尘不染]状态，持续13秒，期间杜苏拉或安娜塔莎会每间隔2.5秒，攻击敌人1次，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害，并获得1层[惊吓]，至多获得6层[惊吓]；招式发动后重置杜苏拉和安娜塔莎离场倒计时。
basic.triggerEn: After Rina uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Spotless state for 13s. During this time, Drusilla or Anastella attacks an enemy once every 2.5s, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG, and grants 1 stack of Fright, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

basic.name: 普通攻击：午夜清扫（潜能觉醒）
basic.trigger: 当[惊吓]达到6层时，杜苏拉或安娜塔莎下一次发动[普通攻击：晨间清扫]会消耗全部[惊吓]，改为发动[普通攻击：午夜清扫]，造成电属性伤害；招式发动后重置杜苏拉和安娜塔莎离场倒计时。
basic.triggerEn: When Fright reaches 6 stacks, the next Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup performed by Drusilla or Anastella consumes all Fright stacks and is replaced with Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup, dealing Electric DMG. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

fields.textEn: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + 12%, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.

fields.text:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[感电]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒；场上存在处于[感电]状态下的敌人时，全队角色造成的电属性伤害提升10%。
fields.textEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
Increases the duration of Shock inflicted on enemies by any character by 3s. When Shocked enemies are on the field, all squad members' Electric DMG increases by 10%.

fields.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
指派安娜塔莎发动下砸攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

fields.name: 强化特殊技：笨蛋消失魔法
fields.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
fields.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
fields.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎发动持续下砸攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，将触发[快速支援]。
fields.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to unleash a continuous downward smash attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

fields.name: 闪避：抚平裙摆
fields.trigger: 点按 【闪避键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Dodge] to activate:
fields.description:
点按 【闪避键】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 冲刺攻击：突然惊吓
fields.trigger: 闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
fields.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.

fields.name: 闪避反击：邦布回魂
fields.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
fields.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方旋转飞出并触发爆炸，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 连携技：侍者守则
fields.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
fields.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
fields.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并生成球形电场，造成大量电属性伤害；
杜苏拉和安娜塔莎在推进期间无法响应[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]的指令，但可以通过发动[普通攻击：赶走傻瓜]将其召回丽娜身边；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]。
fields.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, Special Attacks, and EX Special Attacks, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

fields.name: 终结技：女王的侍从们
fields.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
fields.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并发动高速回旋，造成大量电属性伤害；
杜苏拉和安娜塔莎在推进期间无法响应[普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]的指令，但可以通过发动[普通攻击：赶走傻瓜]将其召回丽娜身边；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后，将触发[快速支援]。
fields.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered.

fields.name: 快速支援：二拍的阿勒芒德
fields.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方旋转飞出并触发爆炸，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 回避支援：三拍的库朗特
fields.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
fields.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 支援突击：四拍的加沃特
fields.trigger: 发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
fields.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
fields.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
指派杜苏拉和安娜塔莎，向前方持续推进并生成涡旋电场，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间，可以快速衔接[强化特殊技：笨蛋消失魔法]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
fields.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to continuously advance while generating a vortex of electricity, dealing Electric DMG.
While using this skill, Rina can quickly chain into EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

fields.name: 普通攻击：晨间清扫（潜能觉醒）
fields.trigger: 当丽娜发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]后，进入[一尘不染]状态，持续13秒，期间杜苏拉或安娜塔莎会每间隔2.5秒，攻击敌人1次，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害，并获得1层[惊吓]，至多获得6层[惊吓]；招式发动后重置杜苏拉和安娜塔莎离场倒计时。
fields.triggerEn: After Rina uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Spotless state for 13s. During this time, Drusilla or Anastella attacks an enemy once every 2.5s, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG, and grants 1 stack of Fright, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.
fields.description: 当丽娜发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]后，进入[一尘不染]状态，持续13秒，期间杜苏拉或安娜塔莎会每间隔2.5秒，攻击敌人1次，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害，并获得1层[惊吓]，至多获得6层[惊吓]；招式发动后重置杜苏拉和安娜塔莎离场倒计时。
fields.descriptionEn: After Rina uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Spotless state for 13s. During this time, Drusilla or Anastella attacks an enemy once every 2.5s, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG, and grants 1 stack of Fright, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

fields.name: 普通攻击：午夜清扫（潜能觉醒）
fields.trigger: 当[惊吓]达到6层时，杜苏拉或安娜塔莎下一次发动[普通攻击：晨间清扫]会消耗全部[惊吓]，改为发动[普通攻击：午夜清扫]，造成电属性伤害；招式发动后重置杜苏拉和安娜塔莎离场倒计时。
fields.triggerEn: When Fright reaches 6 stacks, the next Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup performed by Drusilla or Anastella consumes all Fright stacks and is replaced with Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup, dealing Electric DMG. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.
fields.description: 当[惊吓]达到6层时，杜苏拉或安娜塔莎下一次发动[普通攻击：晨间清扫]会消耗全部[惊吓]，改为发动[普通攻击：午夜清扫]，造成电属性伤害；招式发动后重置杜苏拉和安娜塔莎离场倒计时。
fields.descriptionEn: When Fright reaches 6 stacks, the next Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup performed by Drusilla or Anastella consumes all Fright stacks and is replaced with Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup, dealing Electric DMG. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

fields.name: 核心被动：迷你毁灭拍档
fields.trigger: 指派杜苏拉或安娜塔莎进行攻击时，队伍中其他角色的穿透率随丽娜自身的穿透率提升，提升效果等同于丽娜25%穿透率+12%，最高提升30%，杜苏拉和安娜塔莎均返回丽娜身边后，对应增益效果结束。
fields.triggerEn: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + 12%, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.
fields.description: 指派杜苏拉或安娜塔莎进行攻击时，队伍中其他角色的穿透率随丽娜自身的穿透率提升，提升效果等同于丽娜25%穿透率+12%，最高提升30%，杜苏拉和安娜塔莎均返回丽娜身边后，对应增益效果结束。
fields.descriptionEn: When ordering Drusilla or Anastella to attack, other squad members' PEN Ratio increases together with Rina's, by 25% of Rina's PEN Ratio + 12%, up to 30%. The effect ends when both Drusilla and Anastella return to Rina.

fields.name: 额外能力：完美舞会
fields.trigger: 队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
fields.triggerEn: When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
fields.description:
队伍中存在与自身属性或阵营相同的角色时触发：
队伍中任意角色对敌人施加[感电]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒；场上存在处于[感电]状态下的敌人时，全队角色造成的电属性伤害提升10%。
fields.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
Increases the duration of Shock inflicted on enemies by any character by 3s. When Shocked enemies are on the field, all squad members' Electric DMG increases by 10%.

fields.trigger: 本阶未单列额外能力文本；技能变化见对应的潜能觉醒变体。
fields.triggerEn: No separate ability text is provided for this rank; see the corresponding awakened skill variants.

fields.trigger: 穿透率提升1.6%；[核心被动：迷你毁灭拍档]中获得的增益效果存在期间，基于丽娜自身穿透率每1%，全队角色攻击力和防御力分别提升3点和2.5点，至多提升576点攻击力和468点防御力。
fields.triggerEn: PEN Ratio increases by 1.6%. While the buff gained from Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner is active, for every 1% of Rina's PEN Ratio, all squad members gain 3 ATK and 2.5 DEF, up to a maximum of 576 ATK and 468 DEF.

fields.triggerEn: PEN Ratio increases by 1.6%. While the buff gained from Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner is active, for every 1% of Rina's PEN Ratio, all squad members gain 6.7 ATK and 5.5 DEF, up to a maximum of 576 ATK and 468 DEF.
